The described behavior is correct-but-unexplained cross-multiplication (a black-box procedure), which is not whole-number bias; the skill correctly avoided fabricating a whole-number-bias code. The expectation punishes a correct diagnosis. Either change the scenario to exhibit actual whole-number bias, or reword to test that the procedural/conceptual split is captured with >=2 observations.
